name: learnpath
description: Run scripts for the whole LearnPath project (backend + frontend + Docker services)

scripts.setup: npm run services:up && npm install --prefix backend && cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npm run db:seed && cd .. && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npm run services:up && concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.db:deploy: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:status: cd backend && npx prisma migrate status
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run ng -- lint
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
